name: Hengli Petrochemical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hengli Petrochemical Co.,Ltd. engages in petrochemical industry in China and internationally. The company operates through Petrochemical Business and Polyester Fiber Business segments. It offers oil refining products, chemical products, purified terephthalic acid, polyester chips, and polyester fibers; and engineering plastics, functional films, and biodegradable materials. The company also provides civilian and industrial polyester filament; and polyester filament. In addition, it engages in wholesale and retail activities; transportation industry; and industrial investment activities, as well as other financial services.
